subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Green Hydrogen in Logistics
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Green Hydrogen in Logistics.

hook.text: A fuel made from water and renewable energy that emits only water vapor. Green hydrogen could power heavy freight.

buildup.text: Green hydrogen is produced by splitting water using renewable electricity. It stores clean energy as a gas.

discovery.text: It can power long-haul trucks, ships, and trains where batteries are too heavy or range is too short.

twist.text: Green hydrogen costs 3–5x more than diesel today. Infrastructure barely exists. Scale is years away.

climax.text: Maersk, Hyundai, and Daimler are all investing billions in hydrogen-powered freight vehicles.

punchline.text: Hydrogen is the clean fuel for the hardest-to-decarbonize freight.
